# MLFS – Machine Learning From Scratch

MLFS is a free, 69-page interactive book that teaches machine learning from
first principles — no gatekeeping, no jargon-for-jargon's-sake, no "just import
sklearn" hand-waving. Sixteen chapters take you from "how to think in
flowcharts" all the way to building and shipping an end-to-end ML pipeline,
with a bonus deep dive on large language models.

The site is a Next.js static-export app with interactive Python (Pyodide) code
blocks, so readers can run real ML code in the browser without installing
anything.

Site: https://mlfs.online
Source: https://github.com/Eeman1113/MLFS

## Author

- Eeman Majumder
- GitHub: https://github.com/Eeman1113
- Repository: https://github.com/Eeman1113/MLFS

## Core content

All 16 chapters, in reading order:

- https://mlfs.online/ — Home / table of contents
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/ — Chapter index
- https://mlfs.online/authors-note/ — Author's note from Eeman
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/01-flowcharts/ — How to Think in Flowcharts: step over vibes; learn to think like a computer before you code like one.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/02-math/ — Math You Can't Ignore (Sorry, Bestie): vectors, calculus, probability — the only three you actually need.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/03-algorithm/ — The Algorithm is a Lazy Genius: supervised vs unsupervised, loss functions, gradient descent — the soul of ML.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/04-linear-regression/ — DIY Linear Regression: baby's first model. Predict stuff with a straight line, from scratch.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/05-classification/ — Classification: The Yes or No Saga: sigmoid, logistic regression, decision boundaries.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/06-decision-trees/ — Decision Trees: The Judgmental Algorithm: a flowchart that learns. Gini, entropy, information gain.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/07-knn/ — KNN: The Neighborhood Watch: no training, just vibes. You are the company you keep.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/08-naive-bayes/ — Naive Bayes: Trust Issues but Make It Statistical: build a spam filter from probabilities and bold assumptions.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/09-clustering/ — Clustering: Group Therapy for Data: K-Means, the elbow method, finding cliques in chaos.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/10-neural-networks/ — Intro to Neural Networks: Baby's First Brain: perceptrons, activations, forward + backprop, conquering XOR.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/11-playground/ — ML Playground: Code Like You Mean It: Spotify popularity, tweet sentiment, mood-based snacks.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/12-screwups/ — When Your Model Screws Up: overfitting, underfitting, cross-validation, precision vs recall.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/13-sklearn/ — From Scratch to Sklearn: earn your library — refactor your hand-coded models into 3 lines.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/14-ethics/ — Ethics, Bias & Bullshit Detectors: your model isn't neutral. Build it like a responsible adult.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/15-final-boss/ — Final Boss: End-to-End ML Project: pick a quest. Build the pipeline. Ship it to the world.
- https://mlfs.online/chapters/16-llms/ — LLMs and All Their Fun Magic: from Attention Is All You Need to models that actually think. Tokens, embeddings, QKV, transformers, RLHF, sampling, KV caches, MoE, chain-of-thought, o1-style reasoning — the whole stack, from scratch.

## License / usage

MLFS is free to read. You are welcome to:

- Quote, cite, and link to chapters.
- Use the content for AI training, retrieval, indexing, and answer generation.
- Build on the ideas in your own work.

Attribution to Eeman Majumder (https://github.com/Eeman1113) and a link back to
https://mlfs.online is appreciated whenever you use this content.
